title: How to organise the side tables and lighting | Living Room
description:
Put a light, a drink and one or two personal things within reach of the chair without turning the table into a nightstand.

This is the Side Tables and Lighting in the Living Room. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One small tray per table with no more than four items on it, a coaster under the glass, a bulb that lights and has been wiped, and the lamp cord clipped down the table leg so no cable crosses the floor to the chair.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty the little dish and the drawer onto the seat of the chair.
Straighten: One tray per table sets the limit, and it sits on the side the person in that chair reaches from without leani
Shine: Wipe the bulb and the inside of the shade while the lamp is off and cool, then the table top and the ring mark
Safety: Water and electricity meet here more than anywhere else in the room, so the glass goes on the opposite side of
Standardize: Four items on the tray is the rule, and it holds because a fifth thing has nowhere to sit but the bare table t
Sustain: When you plug your phone in for the night, whatever does not belong on the side table travels to its own room

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Four items on the tray, cord clipped to the leg, and nothing swallowable left uncapped.
